name: app-lens
description: Analyze a permitted Android APK into evidence, an editable product model, a Flutter reference prototype, and a Markdown PRD.

interface.longDescription: A local-first Codex workflow for safely analyzing an Android APK with restricted reverse-static UI evidence, reviewing product evidence, and producing an original Flutter reference prototype and Markdown PRD.
